verdict.rationale: Justworks is an HR, payroll and PEO SaaS that could plausibly offer workflow automations with versioning, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about versioning, reviewing or rolling back automations. The closest items, an automatic Xero invoice sync setting and auto-recurring holidays, are adjacent automation settings with no version history, change review or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
